derivation:
simpa [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_scalar, Matrix.scalar_apply] using
    Matrix.diagonal_mul (fun _ => (c : R)) (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) i j
explanation: Matrix.diagonal_mul states `(diagonal d * M) i j = d i * M i j`. Specializing `m := Fin 2`, `n := Fin 2`, `d := fun _ => (c : R)` and `M := (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R)` gives the desired entry formula. The left-hand side of the target becomes the diagonal-matrix product after `Units.val_mul`, `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_scalar`, and `Matrix.scalar_apply`, all of which are definitional/simp lemmas. The library's current proof instead uses `Matrix.smul_eq_diagonal_mul`, `Matrix.smul_apply`, and `smul_eq_mul`, so it does not directly apply `Matrix.diagonal_mul`.
